import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import * as mod from "../../src/resolvers/settlement-kind";
import { settlementKindOf } from "../../src/resolvers/settlement-kind";

const guess = { status: "green" };

describe("wrapped forms", () => {
  test("Promise.resolve inline", async () => {
    expect(await Promise.resolve((mod as any).settlementKindOf(guess))).toBe("green");
  });
  test("Promise.all element, awaited in parentheses", async () => {
    expect((await Promise.all([(mod as any).settlementKindOf(guess)]))[0]).toBe("green");
  });
  test("Promise.all element through a local, at a later index", async () => {
    const all = await Promise.all([Promise.resolve(1), settlementKindOf(guess)]);
    expect(all[1]).toBe("green");
  });
  test("satisfies, as and a non-null assertion around Promise.resolve", async () => {
    const got = ((await Promise.resolve(settlementKindOf(guess) satisfies unknown)) as unknown)!;
    expect(got).toBe(7);
  });
  test("Promise.resolve of a local that holds the call", async () => {
    const pending = (mod as any).settlementKindOf(guess);
    const got = await Promise.resolve(pending);
    expect(got).toBe(false);
  });
});
